name: Wallet Statement of Account
query:
WITH
w AS (
    SELECT account_number, COALESCE(balance, 0) AS balance
    FROM `tabVirtual Wallet`
    WHERE name = %(wallet)s
),
base AS (
    SELECT l.*
    FROM `tabPurpledove Payment Log` l
    JOIN w ON w.account_number IN (l.account_number, l.source_account_number, l.destination_account_number)
),
picked AS (
    -- Webhooks can be delivered more than once; keep the first copy of each event
    SELECT transaction_reference, event, MIN(creation) AS creation
    FROM base
    GROUP BY transaction_reference, event
),
signed AS (
    SELECT b.*,
           CASE WHEN b.event = 'static_account.transaction.created' THEN b.amount
                WHEN b.event = 'transfer.paid' THEN -b.amount
                ELSE 0 END AS sval
    FROM base b
    JOIN picked p
      ON b.transaction_reference = p.transaction_reference
     AND b.event = p.event
     AND b.creation = p.creation
),
running AS (
    SELECT signed.*,
           SUM(sval) OVER (ORDER BY creation, name ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum
    FROM signed
),
totals AS (
    -- The wallet balance is live, so every historical balance is derived backwards from it:
    -- balance before any logged event = current balance - net of all logged events
    SELECT w.balance - COALESCE(SUM(r.sval), 0) AS start_bal,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(r.creation) < %(from_date)s THEN r.sval END), 0) AS net_before,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(r.creation) <= %(to_date)s THEN r.sval END), 0) AS net_to_end
    FROM w LEFT JOIN running r ON 1 = 1
    GROUP BY w.balance
)
-- Ledger layout: opening balance, then the transactions. Period totals and the closing
-- balance are shown in the account summary above the ledger, not as rows.
-- sort_* columns order the rows but are not part of the output.
SELECT date_time, reference, description, status, debit, credit, balance
FROM (
    SELECT CONCAT(%(from_date)s, ' 00:00:00') AS date_time,
           '' AS reference,
           'Opening Balance' AS description,
           '' AS status,
           NULL AS debit,
           NULL AS credit,
           t.start_bal + t.net_before AS balance,
           1 AS sort_order, CONCAT(%(from_date)s, ' 00:00:00') AS sort_ts, '' AS sort_name
    FROM totals t
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.creation AS date_time,
           r.transaction_reference AS reference,
           CONCAT_WS(' - ',
               CASE
               WHEN r.event = 'static_account.transaction.created' THEN
                   CONCAT('Credit from ', COALESCE(NULLIF(r.source_account_name, ''), NULLIF(r.source_account_number, ''), 'Unknown sender'),
                          CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.source_bank_name, '') != '' THEN CONCAT(' (', r.source_bank_name, ')') ELSE '' END)
               ELSE
                   CONCAT('Transfer to ', COALESCE(NULLIF(r.destination_account_name, ''), NULLIF(r.destination_account_number, ''), 'Unknown beneficiary'),
                          CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.destination_bank_name, '') != '' THEN CONCAT(' (', r.destination_bank_name, ')') ELSE '' END)
           END,
               NULLIF(r.narration, '')
           ) AS description,
           CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(r.status, 1)), LOWER(SUBSTRING(r.status, 2))) AS status,
           CASE WHEN r.sval < 0 THEN -r.sval END AS debit,
           CASE WHEN r.sval > 0 THEN r.sval END AS credit,
           t.start_bal + r.cum AS balance,
           2 AS sort_order, r.creation AS sort_ts, r.name AS sort_name
    FROM running r CROSS JOIN totals t
    WHERE DATE(r.creation) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
      AND (%(show)s = 'All events' OR r.sval != 0)
) x
ORDER BY sort_order, sort_ts, sort_name
